_: Routes that carry no wallet control, and no way for the menu to attach to one, which are nevertheless deliberate. `node tools/check-wallet-menu.js` prints each exemption with its reason, so an exemption is a sentence in the output rather than a route that quietly stopped being checked. The rule it exists to protect is real — My Portfolio is only reachable through that menu, and `/dungeons` and `/tokenomics` both shipped it broken — so a route belongs here only when it is deliberately *not* the game. If a page should have the menu, give it the menu.
/: The public coming-soon page at dungeonknights.io. It is the page a stranger lands on, before they have a wallet or any interest in the game, and it deliberately has no wallet connection at all: its two calls to action are the Points Program and the Genesis waitlist, both of which work without one. The game — and the menu — is on app.dungeonknights.io, one redirect away.
/gate: The password screen on app.dungeonknights.io. Its whole job is to be reachable *before* any cookie exists, so it loads nothing the game loads and offers nothing to click except the password field. A wallet menu here would be a menu on a page nobody has got past yet, and every dependency it added would be one more thing that has to work before the door opens.
/genesis: The Genesis collection page at the apex, opened by the landing page's second button. Like `/`, it is written for somebody who has no wallet yet — that is exactly who a waitlist is for — so it loads no wallet source and has nothing to attach a menu to. The address it asks for is typed text, not a connection, and the page says so. It is public on the apex and behind the password on the game host, where it is not meant to be reached anyway.
